purpose: Turn FAQ usage, search, EOI sources, and persona engagement into monthly content recommendations that strengthen WMC’s community care, continuity of care, and GP employer brand — without recruitment-agency tone.

community_care.label: Community care
community_care.messaging: Inner-south community general practice serving local patients with accessible, team-based care.

continuity_of_care.label: Continuity of care
continuity_of_care.messaging: Patients return to a known GP; list-building and ongoing relationships over high-volume churn.

gp_employer_brand.label: GP employer brand
gp_employer_brand.messaging: Practice-to-doctor honesty: nursing/reception support, AGPAL systems, clear onboarding boundaries, no marketplace hype.

guards: Do not recommend publishing earnings % or rate cards
Do not imply WMC issues Medicare provider numbers
Do not invent eligibility or migration advice content
Prefer practice voice over recruiter language
Recommendations are advisory for human editors

signalSources.searchKeywords: organic search queries / Search Console style keywords (seeded for prototype)
signalSources.internalSearch: on-site search terms on GP decision surfaces

scoring.highConvertingPage: sessions reaching eoi_submit / page_view sessions (min sample)
scoring.unansweredQuestion: internal search or FAQ vote=not_helpful without matching FAQ id, or keyword with no content mapping
